title: Meaningful UI animation directing eye and reducing cognitive load
statement:
Meaningful UI animation reduces cognitive load by actively directing the user's eye to the exact location of a new or updated element, preventing visual search.

Options:
- Eye Guide: Directed spatial slide-in (fits: new list items, incoming messages)
- In-place Update: Subtle background color flash (fits: data table refreshes, stock tickers)
- High Cognitive Load: No animation (Instant snap) (fits: avoid for partial updates)
appliesWhen: Applies to: list updates, shopping carts, notifications. Audience: general.
